messages.subject: Lunchtime CPD: 'Warranty & indemnity insurance — market update'
messages.plaintextBody: You're invited to a lunchtime CPD session on Thursday 5 February, 12:30–13:30 in the Bishopsgate training room (sandwiches provided). Our guest speaker from a leading W&I broker will cover current pricing, retention trends and recent claims experience. 1 hour CPD. RSVP to L&D.
